in_arabic.name: Masduq
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Seeker of truth
in_arabic.long_meaning: Masduq هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. One who aspires to seek and find the truth. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'asadaqa', which means 'to seek' or 'to strive'. Masduq is a name for those who are dedicated to the pursuit of knowledge and truth, and who are willing to go to great lengths to uncover the hidden wisdom of the universe.
